source_spans.quote: The chief executive officer of a State desiring to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title shall designate, in an application submitted to the Secretary under subsection (b), an appropriate State agency that complies with the requirements of paragraph (2) to act as a lead agency for purposes of carrying out State activities under this chapter.

claim_judgments.rationale: Claim C0025 accurately captures the requirement in 42 U.S.C. 9908(a)(1) that the chief executive officer of a State desiring grant or allotment funding under section 9905 or 9906 must designate a qualifying lead agency in the application submitted under subsection (b).

source_spans.quote:
(2) Duties The lead agency shall—

(A) develop the State plan to be submitted to the Secretary under subsection (b);

(B) in conjunction with the development of the State plan as required under subsection (b), hold at least one hearing in the State with sufficient time and statewide distribution of notice of such hearing, to provide to the public an opportunity to comment on the proposed use and distribution of funds to be provided through the grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title for the period covered by the State plan; and

(C) conduct reviews of eligible entities under section 9914 of this title.

claim_judgments.rationale: Claim C0026 completely and faithfully captures the three duties assigned to the lead agency under subsection (a)(2): developing the State plan, holding a public hearing with adequate advance notice, and conducting reviews of eligible entities under section 9914.

source_spans.quote: In order to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title, the State shall hold at least one legislative hearing every 3 years in conjunction with the development of the State plan.

claim_judgments.rationale: Claim C0027 correctly captures the eligibility mandate in subsection (a)(3) requiring the State to hold at least one legislative hearing every 3 years in conjunction with the development of the State plan. The actor 'the State' and mandatory modality are directly supported.

While C0028 spans the entire subsection (b) from F013 through F047, its summary collapses paragraphs (1) through (13) into a cross-reference ('the assurances and descriptions specified in paragraphs (1) through (13) of subsection (b)') without stating any of the substantive statutory assurances and program descriptions enacted in those paragraphs.

source_spans.quote:
(c) Funding termination or reductions For purposes of making a determination in accordance with subsection (b)(8) with respect to—

(1) a funding reduction, the term “cause” includes—

(A) a statewide redistribution of funds provided through a community services block grant under this chapter to respond to—

(i) the results of the most recently available census or other appropriate data;

(ii) the designation of a new eligible entity; or

(iii) severe economic dislocation; or


(B) the failure of an eligible entity to comply with the terms of an agreement or a State plan, or to meet a State requirement, as described in section 9915(a) of this title; and


(2) a termination, the term “cause” includes the failure of an eligible entity to comply with the terms of an agreement or a State plan, or to meet a State requirement, as described in section 9915(a) of this title.

claim_judgments.rationale: Claim C0029 accurately states the statutory definition of 'cause' under subsection (c) for both funding reductions and terminations, retaining all specified grounds including demographic redistribution, new entity designation, economic dislocation, and compliance failure.

source_spans.quote: The Secretary may prescribe procedures for the purpose of assessing the effectiveness of eligible entities in carrying out the purposes of this chapter.

claim_judgments.rationale: Claim C0030 correctly captures the permissive authority of the Secretary under subsection (d) to prescribe procedures for assessing eligible entities' effectiveness.

source_spans.quote: The chief executive officer of each State may revise any plan prepared under this section and shall submit the revised plan to the Secretary.

claim_judgments.rationale: Claim C0031 accurately retains both the chief executive officer's discretion to revise the plan and the mandatory obligation to submit any revised plan to the Secretary pursuant to subsection (e)(1).

source_spans.quote: Each plan or revised plan prepared under this section shall be made available for public inspection within the State in such a manner as will facilitate review of, and comment on, the plan.

claim_judgments.rationale: Claim C0032 faithfully represents the public inspection requirement under subsection (e)(2) for each plan or revised plan prepared under section 9908.
